fields.name: id
fields.coerce: none: used as a key of `chests`
fields.description: The chest id from the `drop` event: a random string of 30 characters (`randomStr(30)`, node/server.js:2242).

responses.name: Opened
responses.when: All checks pass. Without a party (or for an encouragement chest) you get one. In a party, each member online gets one, with `party: true`, `items` kept as `[]` when empty, and the gold of that member. Without a party, the server removes `items` when it is empty.

confirm.live_needed: `items` holds `cache_item` copies whose keys depend on the dropped item; a capture shows a real chest.

responses.name: Cave chest
responses.when: A chest of a Cave of Many Dreams run (`chest.cave`) opens. `gold` is 0, `goldm` is 1, `items` is `[]`, and `cave` holds the gold and the amber that went to the purse of the run, not to you. Every member of the run gets this object. There is no `game_response`.

failures.intro: A null payload throws before the character check, at `chests[data.id]`.

rows.when: Cave chest: the run is closed or ended, you are not an active member, you are not on the map and instance of the chest, or you are dead.
Cave chest: the run is paused.
Cave chest: you are more than 400 px from the chest.
Cave chest: someone opened it already.
An encouragement chest (it has `character`) that is not for your character, your account and your encouragement group.
You are on `woffice` or on a mount map (the bank), or you are invisible. The chest does not need to exist for this check.
Without a party (or an encouragement chest): your inventory has no space for all of `chest.items`.
The chest does not exist (someone opened it, or it expired).
An error during the loot. The server deletes the chest first, so items and gold that it already gave stay given, and the rest is lost.

also.to: you; in a party, every member
also.when: Success: one for each item (`Found a ...`, `Looted ...`, `Lost ...`; in a party with the name of the looter), then one for the gold if it is not 0 (phrase `server.game_log.gold`, `phrase_args.amount` is the pretty-printed gold; each member gets its own; node/server.js:11376, 11537).

also.to: you; in a party, every member in your instance
also.when: Success, after the gold `game_log`. `args.color` is `"+gold"` without a party and `"gold"` in a party.

fields.name: message
fields.description: `"+"` and the gold of the receiver.

fields.name: y
fields.description: The y of the chest minus 10.

also.to: you; in a party, every member
also.when: Success, before `chest_opened`. It has `reopen: true` for a receiver that got an item.
also.summary: Your state with the new `gold` and `items`.

also.name: Big gold
also.when: The chest is not a PvP chest, it has more than 100,000,000 gold, and you are not `stealth`. Sent before the loot.

also.name: Rare item
also.when: `add_item` gives a rare item (its `G.items[name].a` score) or a shiny item, unless the receiver is `stealth`. Each item of the chest can turn shiny: 1 in 500 for an upgradable item, 1 in 20,000 for a compoundable item (not for `pvp_items`).

confirm.live_needed: Whether an item is announced depends on G (`G.items[name].a`), the running `a_score` and a random shiny roll.

example.message: Wizard found a Shiny Amulet of HP
example.name: Wizard

also.to: each encouragement contributor that is not a looter
also.when: The chest has encouragement receipts. Each contributor online gets its own drops and gold, and a `chest_opened` with only its own items.
also.summary: `{id, goldm, opener, items, gold}` with the items and gold of that contributor, plus `dry` / `stale` when the opener's reply has them. `items` is removed when empty. Sent only when the contributor got gold, items or shells; a contributor without inventory space gets a reserved chest dropped instead.

confirm.live_needed: Needs a chest with encouragement receipts from a contributor outside the party.

also.summary: `{type: "state", state}`: a new snapshot of the run, with the new purse.

Normal: `server_message` to everyone, for a chest with more than 100,000,000 gold
`game_log` for each item, then one for the gold
`player` to you (and to each member in a party)
`chest_opened` to you (and to each member in a party)
Cave chest: `chest_opened` to every member of the run
`cave` to the members of the run
